newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends little changed in low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends little changed in low volumes.

text.p: 1255 GMT - Romania's leu ended Tuesday near 6,750/850 to the dollar, close to 6,700/7,000 in early trading hours.
* Traders said interbank volumes had been thin and most spreads had narrowed to some 300-400 lei from about 800 over the past weeks.
* But they said a few players continued to keep out of the market posting huge spreads with their leu-dollar prices at 6,200/9,400 or 7,000/8,400.

* Short-term money market rates stayed flat near 225 percent. Dealers said some banks, keen to fulfil their reserve targets in advance, were chasing leu funds, helping prices to cling to current levels.
* Leu retail rates firmed slightly to 6,850/7,400 to the dollar from some 7,000/800 in the morning.
